verdict.rationale: Stripe's payouts docs say funds move from the available balance to the bank as payouts, and that Instant Payouts can be sent any time, usually arriving within 30 minutes. That covers the 'speed it up when I need cash' half of the story. The evidence never shows a per-payout view of expected arrival dates, never mentions a next-day option, and never ties payouts to Terminal-specific in-person funds. Missing for 10: per-payout arrival-date visibility or schedule tracking, a next-day payout option, Terminal-specific payout docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
